positions.title: System Architecture Intern
positions.description:
- Worked as part of a small team (4 people) on an internal software product to assist with the development of an emerging memory technology.
- Designed and implemented a simulation module to emulate the execution of internally developed microcode.
- Assisted hardware development team with hardware/microcode interface design.
- Communicated with team members and other internal customers to meet their needs.
- Developed with C, C++, Python, Bash, Autotools, and Git.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked as part of a small team (6-10 people) on a large software project within the electric power industry.
- Participated in Agile Methodologies such as pair programming and sprint planning.
- Assisted with software engineering tasks such as build maintenance and code reviews.
- Worked with C++, CMake, Jenkins CI, and Mercurial.

positions.title: DRAM Product Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked as part of a team to test, verify, and document results for issues concerning Micron’s Hybrid Memory Cube (HMC) products. HMC is a type of dynamic random access memory (DRAM) intended for high performance computing. It achieves exceptionally high memory bandwidth by utilizing through-silicon via (TSV) technology to create interconnects between multiple vertically stacked silicon dies.
- Developed software to automate configuring and testing of an HMC device and reporting test results.
- Developed a graphical user interface to display internal traffic and routing within an HMC device.
- Maintained documentation of all results and gave a final presentation.
